summary: Contributed to production readiness and development of Partner and User mobile apps using React Native. Developed CRM, booking, package management, and customer engagement features. Integrated Razorpay subscriptions, Vehicle Tag workflows, deep linking, and OCR-assisted vehicle number plate scanning. Managed Android release builds and resolved production issues.

Contributed to a React-based ticket management platform by developing UI features and resolving application issues. Maintained and implemented new screens for a legacy React Native dating application, generating mobile builds and assisting with API documentation.
Contributed to frontend development using React across multiple web applications. Developed HRMS-related modules and collaborated using Git-based development workflows.
